createCustomerAddress.description: The `createCustomerAddress` function creates an address for an existing customer using the `CustomerAddressesModel` object as an argument. The function calls the [`createCustomerAddress`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/mutations/create-customer-address/) mutation.

address.description: The new address details including street, city, region, country, postal code, and optional fields like company name and phone number.

getAttributesForm.description: The `getAttributesForm` function calls the [`attributesForm`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/attributes/queries/attributes-form/) query to retrieve EAV attributes associated with customer and customer address frontend forms. The `formCode` parameter must be one of the following values: `customer_account_create`, `customer_account_edit`, `customer_address_create`, or `customer_address_edit`.

getCountries.description: The `getCountries` function calls the [`countries`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/directory/queries/countries/) query to retrieve a list of countries.

getCustomer.description: The `getCustomer` function retrieves the customer information for the logged-in customer. The function calls the [`customer`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/queries/customer/) query.

getCustomerAddress.description: The `getCustomerAddress` function returns an array of addresses associated with the current customer. The function calls the [`customer`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/queries/customer/) query.

getOrderHistoryList.description: The `getOrderHistoryList` function is an asynchronous function that retrieves a list of customer orders using the [`customer`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/queries/customer/) query. It optionally takes parameters for pagination and filtering.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of results to return at once. The default value is 20.

selectOrdersDate.description: Represents a date filter for the orders.

currentPage.description: The current page of the order history list. The default value is 1.

getRegions.description: The `getRegions` function calls the [`country`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/directory/queries/country/) query to retrieve a list of states or provinces for a specific country.

countryCode.description: A two-letter abbreviation for the country ID.

getStoreConfig.description: The `getStoreConfig` function calls the [`storeConfig`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/store/queries/store-config/) query to retrieve details about password requirements.

removeCustomerAddress.description: The `removeCustomerAddress` function removes an address associated with the current customer. The function calls the [`deleteCustomerAddress`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/mutations/delete-address/) mutation.

addressId.description: An internal ID for the address.

updateCustomer.description:
The `updateCustomer` function updates the logged-in customer. The function calls the [`updateCustomerV2`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/mutations/update-v2/) mutation.

The `form` object keys are converted to snake_case using the `convertKeysCase` utility with specific mappings for `firstName`, `lastName`, `middleName`, and `custom_attributesV2`.

form.description: The customer attributes to update, such as firstName, lastName, email, date of birth, and custom attributes.

updateCustomerAddress.description:
The `updateCustomerAddress` function updates an address associated with the current customer. The function calls the [`updateCustomerAddress`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/mutations/update-address/) mutation.

The `forms` object includes an `addressId`, which is a number representing the ID of the address to be updated and other address details as defined in `CustomerAddressesModel`.

forms.description: The addressId and address attributes to update, such as street, city, region, country, and postal code.

updateCustomerEmail.description: The `updateCustomerEmail` function updates the email address of the logged-in customer. The function calls the [`updateCustomerEmail`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/mutations/update-email/) mutation.

email.description: The new email address of the customer.

password.description: The current password of the customer.

updateCustomerPassword.description: The `updateCustomerPassword` function updates the password of the logged-in customer. The function calls the [`changeCustomerPassword`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/mutations/change-password/) mutation.

options.description: An object containing `currentPassword` (the password before it is changed) and `newPassword` (the new password).
